Callout.Name: Cash in Transit Robbery
Callout.Message: Armoured van crew robbed during a delivery.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects on a black motorbike, cash box taken.

Script.Line: It was two of them on a bike. I was on the ground.
They took the box and went north. I did not get a look.
One of them had a shotgun. You need to know that.

Lines.Approach: Cash box taken, two on a black bike. Follow it, do not force it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
